title: Good but expensive
text: Good but expensive. I do really like this vacuum, it has a good battery, good attachments and I like the extendable hose. But I would personally only want to pay $60-$75 tops for it. I purchased a lithium ion Black and Decker Dustbuster for $50 a couple years ago and I like that one just as much for most small cleaning projects around the house. This Bissell does seem to have a bit longer battery life (a few minutes more perhaps) and is just slightly better at cleaning my car, but it doesn’t seem twice as good (like the current $100 price).
